layers.name: Capture
layers.one_sentence: The Brain observes and records everything your organization does, before trying to understand any of it.

layers.name: Understanding
layers.one_sentence: The Brain reads everything it captured and works out what it actually means in terms of how the organization works.

layers.name: Knowledge Objects
layers.one_sentence: Before the Brain can remember anything, it needs a standard way to write things down — that standard format is a Knowledge Object.

layers.name: Memory
layers.one_sentence: The Brain stores everything the organization knows, organized into five types of knowledge that each decay and get queried differently.

layers.name: Intelligence
layers.one_sentence: Memory stores things; Intelligence reads across all of it and figures out what it means — risks, opportunities, and what to do next.

layers.name: Execution
layers.one_sentence: This is where intelligence becomes action — humans and AI agents actually doing the work, informed by everything the Brain knows.

layers.name: Exposure
layers.one_sentence: The Brain delivers memory and intelligence to the right person, at the right moment, through the tool they're already using — without anyone having to ask.

layers.name: Evolution
layers.one_sentence: The Brain doesn't just remember — every time a recommendation succeeds, fails, or gets ignored, it learns from that outcome too.
layers.key_question: What changed because of what we did?

trust.name: Trust
trust.one_sentence: Surrounds every layer rather than sitting in the pipeline — every claim, action, and AI decision stays traceable, challengeable, and accountable to a named authority.

audience_captions.executive: Seven layers handing off cleanly to one another — nothing your company learns falls through the cracks between them.
audience_captions.product: Each layer hands off cleanly to the next — nothing your users do ever just disappears.
audience_captions.engineer: Seven canonical layers, each with a defined input, output, and owner — Trust wraps all seven rather than sitting in the sequence.
audience_captions.new_hire: Think of it like seven departments, each with a specific job, passing work to the next one down the line.
audience_captions.explorer: Click any layer to go deeper — every block here is a doorway into the concept behind it.
